meta.title: Catetin
meta.description: Track IOUs with friends without the awkwardness — and without arguing about numbers.

landing.headline: Track IOUs with friends, without the awkwardness.

mode.s3: Choose Needs confirmation or Trusted group

acceptInvite.title: accept a group invite
acceptInvite.s1: On the Groups page, tap Join (or Decline) on the invite card

add.title: add a person
add.s1: On the People page, tap the add-person icon at the top right
add.s2: Enter their name, then tap Add

connect.title: connect with a friend
connect.s1: On the People page, tap the add-person icon at the top right
connect.s2: Tap Show my QR (or Scan a friend's QR)
connect.ask: make an invite link for a friend
connect.prefix: make an invite link for a friend

rename.title: rename {name}
rename.s3: Type the new name, then tap Save

email.title: set {name}'s email
email.s3: Type the email, then tap Save

remind.title: remind {name}
remind.s1: Tap the bell icon next to Record IOU

trust.title: set up mutual trust with {name}
trust.s1: Tap the Trust each other switch on {name}'s page

unblock.title: unblock someone
unblock.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
unblock.s3: Tap Unblock next to their name

merge.title: merge {name} with another contact
merge.s3: Pick the person who is actually the same

invite.title: invite {name} to Catetin
invite.s3: Share or copy the link to {name}

statement.title: download a statement with {name}
statement.s2: Choose Download PDF, Print, or Download CSV
statement.ask: download a PDF of my records with {name}
statement.prefix: download a PDF of my records with {name}

stats.title: see statistics with {name}
stats.s1: Tap Statistics with {name} below the buttons
stats.ask: how long does {name} usually take to pay back?

respond.title: approve or reject a request
respond.s3: Tap Confirm/Approve or Reject on the card

withdraw.title: withdraw a request
withdraw.s2: Open the Waiting on others tab

dispute.title: dispute a record that applied directly
dispute.s4: Write a reason (optional), then tap Dispute

name.title: change your profile name
name.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
name.s2: Tap your name at the very top
name.s3: Type the new name, then tap Save
name.ask: change my name to Andi Pratama

language.title: change the language
language.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right

currency.title: change your main currency
currency.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
currency.ask: change my main currency to USD

timezone.title: change your time zone
timezone.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
timezone.s3: Search for and pick the time zone
timezone.ask: change my time zone to Makassar (WITA)

theme.title: switch between light and dark mode
theme.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right

notifications.title: set up notifications
notifications.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
notifications.s3: Turn the topics you want on or off

digest.title: set up the email summary
digest.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
digest.ask: send me a weekly email summary

quietHours.title: set quiet hours
quietHours.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
quietHours.s5: Pick the start and end time, then tap Save

push.title: turn on push notifications on this device
push.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
push.s3: Turn on Push notifications, then allow it in the browser

feedback.title: send feedback
feedback.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
feedback.s3: Write your feedback, then tap Send
feedback.ask: send feedback: the save button is too small

signIn.title: manage sign-in methods
signIn.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
signIn.s3: Link Google or review how you sign in

devices.title: sign out of other devices
devices.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
devices.s3: Tap Sign out of all other devices
devices.s4: Tap the red button to confirm

export.title: download all your data
export.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right

delete.title: delete your account
delete.s1: Tap Account at the bottom right
delete.s2: Choose Delete account at the very bottom
delete.s3: Type DELETE, then tap Delete account

find.title: search your records
find.s1: Tap Home at the bottom left
find.s2: Tap the magnifier icon at the top right

filter.title: see & filter all records
filter.s1: Tap Home at the bottom left
filter.s2: In the Unpaid / Recent section, tap All
filter.s3: Tap a filter (Status, People, Category, …) and pick

view.title: see statistics
view.s1: Tap Home at the bottom left
view.ask: who pays back late most often?
